description: Valid tar archives (base64) and the tree entries each must read as, sorted by path in UTF-16 code units (spec/schema/README.md, Snapshot manifest). Parse each from several chunkings; every chunking must give the same tree.

cases.name: ustar
cases.description: POSIX ustar as GNU tar -C dir . writes it: ./ prefixes, the ./ root, 0o755, a setuid mode, an empty file, a UTF-8 name, a long path in the prefix field

cases.name: pax
cases.description: pax records for non-ASCII, spaced, backslash and long names; no ./ prefixes

cases.name: links
cases.description: a hardlink expands to its earlier target's content and mode; in-root symlinks, one relative to its directory and one with a long target, are kept

cases.name: gnu
cases.description: GNU format: a long name and a long link target in ././@LongLink entries

cases.name: padded
cases.description: tarfile's record padding after the two zero blocks: trailing zeros are allowed

cases.name: empty
cases.description: no entries, only the two zero blocks
